items.title: Ray Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: Buddy Collette, and a few guys started coming in

ctx.x: Yeah. Saxophone player, he just died recently, and Buddy Collette, and a few guys started coming in and they were right. They forced the issue because they were guys that could cut the stuff. So I haven’t been doing, what, ten years or so now, I haven’t done any. So I’m sure it’s — I’m not sure, but I would hope that it’s a lot more equal now.
Now do you still get — I don’t know if “residuals” is the correct word?
